first7Days.title: Establish Single Source of Truth
first7Days.description: Migrate all active leads from email inboxes and sticky notes into a dedicated CRM pipeline with explicit deal stages.

first7Days.title: Deploy Structured Intake Form
first7Days.description: Create a unified intake link capturing revenue, time in business, and financing requested to filter non-starters immediately.

first7Days.title: Replace Email Attachments with Secure Uploads
first7Days.description: Stop accepting bank statements via raw email attachments. Implement a secure upload checklist link.

next30Days.title: Codify Lender Credit Box Matrix

next30Days.description: Implement automated SMS/email follow-ups triggered whenever an active file is missing underwriting stipulations.
